critic_risk_flags: Although H aligns semantically with hospitalization rate, an explicit H compartment in SEIHR is likely weakly identifiable in a short single-season series (tradeoffs among E/I/H transition rates), increasing instability and over-parameterization risk relative to delayed_I.

I+H observation map is not well aligned to a hospitalization-rate target and introduces additional ambiguity (mixture weights/scale confounding) that can mask misspecification. With short data, this increases identifiability risk without clear justification over delayed_I.
